answer_1.quote: Generating long-term coherent stories is a longstanding challenge for artificial intelligence... We propose the Recursive Reprompting and Revision framework (Re 3) to generate longer stories.
answer_1.outputs: Long stories (2000-2500 words) with coherent plots and premise relevance

answer_4.quote: All metrics are judged by Amazon Mechanical Turk workers... For interest, coherence, and relevance, workers indicate which story is better... For humanlike and writing issues, workers mark each story individually.
answer_4.guideline: Workers compare two stories per premise and evaluate metrics individually or pairwise.
